name: firewall
title: Prompt firewall: detection vs false positives

config.rules: instruction override, authority claim/approval, tool-call text, role tags, prompt probe, urgency, fake promises, encoded payloads, hidden Unicode, fake clause IDs

notes: The firewall only routes: a flag forces any money action to a human; a block refuses politely. It is bypassable by design — the approval-token check at the tool boundary is what actually prevents unauthorized changes (see redteam.json).
